name: Pulse: Retro Fitness Tracker
subtitle: Calorie counter & workout log
promo: New: pick from 9 coaches with their own voices, see your progress as 80s cartoon art, and unlock 30 illustrated walls. Log a meal by talking, snapping or scanning.
description:
Pulse is a real fitness tracker for food and exercise with a nostalgic 80s vibe. Count calories, log workouts and build habits in seconds, wrapped in neon, synth beats and hand-drawn city art, so you actually stick with it.

LOG ANYTHING, ANY WAY
- Say it: "two eggs and toast, then a 30 minute run" and Pulse logs it all.
- Snap it: take a photo of your plate and get calories and macros.
- Scan it: barcode scanner for packaged food.
- One-tap water, mood and sleep.
- Apple Health sync for steps, workouts, sleep, weight and active energy.
- Hands-free: "Hey Siri, log with Pulse", or put it on the Action Button.

A COACH THAT KNOWS YOUR NUMBERS
- Ask anything about training, nutrition, sleep or recovery and get a straight answer based on your goal and what you've logged today.
- Pick from 9 coaches, each with their own voice: a drill sergeant, a Bronx boxing coach, a Miami trainer who speaks Spanish, an 80s action hero and more.
- Fresh meal and workout plans every morning for your goal: lose fat, build muscle, recomp or maintain.
- Stress and sleep insights tied to what you eat and how you train.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
- Calories, protein, weight and workout trends over 7 days, 30 days and all time, with tips on what to improve.
- A comic-book weekly recap you can share.
- Progress photos: compare the same angle side by side, or turn your progress into 80s cartoon art.

STAY ON TRACK
- Daily quests, XP and 15 crew ranks.
- Unlock 30 illustrated walls that become the background of the whole app.
- Streaks with streak freezes, so one missed day doesn't wipe your progress.
- Reminders for meals, water, workouts and mood, all from one switch.
- Monthly seasons with challenges and badges.
- One-minute brain games to reset, plus 30 original synth tracks and 6 app icons to unlock.

TRAIN WITH YOUR CREW
- Add friends with a link, race the weekly board and keep a crew streak alive.
- Start challenges solo or head to head, and nudge friends who fall behind.

YOUR DATA, YOUR CALL
- No account needed. Sign in with Apple is optional and backs up your progress.
- Delete your account and data anytime in the app.
- No ads, no tracking.

CREDITS
The Coach, plans and recaps use AI credits. Buy credit packs or subscribe to Pulse Pro for 600 credits every month, no account needed. Sign in with Apple to get 50 free credits.

Pulse Pro is an auto-renewable monthly subscription billed to your Apple ID. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://pulseretro.fit/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://pulseretro.fit/privacy.html

Pulse gives general fitness and nutrition guidance generated by AI. It isn't medical advice. Talk to a doctor before big changes to your diet or training.
